versos.hebraico: בָּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִתְגֹּֽדְד֗וּ וְלֹֽא־תָשִׂ֧ימוּ קָרְחָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶ֖ם לָמֵֽת׃

controles.web: You are the children of Yahweh your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
controles.kjv: Ye are the children of the Lord your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
controles.livre: Filhos sois do SENHOR vosso Deus: não vos cortareis, nem poreis calva sobre vossos olhos por morto;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וּבְךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לִֽהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ס

controles.web: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God, and Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
controles.kjv: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God, and the Lord hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.
controles.livre: Porque és povo santo ao SENHOR teu Deus, e o SENHOR te escolheu para que lhe sejas um povo singular dentre todos os povos que estão sobre a face da terra.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל כָּל־תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
controles.livre: Nada abominável comerás.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֥את הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכֵ֑לוּ שׁ֕וֹר שֵׂ֥ה כְשָׂבִ֖ים וְשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּֽים׃

controles.web: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
controles.kjv: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
controles.livre: Estes são os animais que comereis: o boi, a ovelha, e a cabra,

versos.hebraico: אַיָּ֥ל וּצְבִ֖י וְיַחְמ֑וּר וְאַקּ֥וֹ וְדִישֹׁ֖ן וּתְא֥וֹ וָזָֽמֶר׃

controles.web: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.
controles.kjv: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
controles.livre: O cervo, o corço, e o búfalo, e o bode selvagem, e o antílope, e boi selvagem, e cabra selvagem.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־בְּהֵמָ֞ה מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֨סַע֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י פְרָס֔וֹת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof cloven in two and chews the cud, among the animals, that may you eat.
controles.kjv: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
controles.livre: E todo animal de unhas, que tem brecha de duas unhas, e que ruminar entre os animais, esse comereis.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ אֶת־זֶ֞ה לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִמַּֽעֲלֵ֣י הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֥י הַפַּרְסָ֖ה הַשְּׁסוּעָ֑ה אֶֽת־הַ֠גָּמָל וְאֶת־הָאַרְנֶ֨בֶת וְאֶת־הַשָּׁפָ֜ן כִּֽי־מַעֲלֵ֧ה גֵרָ֣ה הֵ֗מָּה וּפַרְסָה֙ לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֔יסוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof cloven: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.
controles.livre: Porém estes não comereis dos que ruminam, ou têm unha fendida: camelo, e lebre, e coelho, porque ruminam, mas não têm unha fendida, vos serão impuros;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַ֠חֲזִיר כִּֽי־מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֥ה הוּא֙ וְלֹ֣א גֵרָ֔ה טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶ֑ם מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִגָּֽעוּ׃ס

controles.web: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their flesh, and you shall not touch their carcasses.
controles.kjv: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
controles.livre: Nem porco: porque tem unha fendida, mas não rumina, vos será impuro. Da carne destes não comereis, nem tocareis seus corpos mortos.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales may you eat.
controles.kjv: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:
controles.livre: Isto comereis de tudo o que está na água: todo o que tem barbatana e escama comereis;

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֵֽין־ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.
controles.kjv: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.
controles.livre: Mas todo o que não tiver barbatana e escama, não comereis: impuro vos será.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־צִפּ֥וֹר טְהֹרָ֖ה תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: Of all clean birds you may eat.
controles.kjv: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.
controles.livre: Toda ave limpa comereis.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־תֹאכְל֖וּ מֵהֶ֑ם הַנֶּ֥שֶׁר וְהַפֶּ֖רֶס וְהָֽעָזְנִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,
controles.kjv: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
controles.livre: E estas são das que não comereis: a água, e o quebra-ossos, e o esmerilhão,

versos.hebraico: וְהָרָאָה֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אַיָּ֔ה וְהַדַּיָּ֖ה לְמִינָֽהּ׃

controles.web: the red kite, the falcon, the kite after its kind,
controles.kjv: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,
controles.livre: E o milhafre, e o abutre, e o falcão segundo sua espécie,

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־עֹרֵ֖ב לְמִינֽוֹ׃

controles.web: every raven after its kind,
controles.kjv: And every raven after his kind,
controles.livre: E todo corvo segundo sua espécie,

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת־הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת־הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת־הַנֵּ֖ץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk after its kind,
controles.kjv: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
controles.livre: E o avestruz, e a coruja, e a gaivota, e o gavião segundo sua espécie,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת־הַיַּנְשׁ֖וּף וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃

controles.web: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,
controles.kjv: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
controles.livre: E o mocho, e o corujão, e a coruja-branca,

versos.hebraico: וְהַקָּאָ֥ת וְאֶֽת־הָרָחָ֖מָה וְאֶת־הַשָּׁלָֽךְ׃

controles.web: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,
controles.kjv: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,
controles.livre: E o pelicano, e o gavião-pescador, e o corvo-marinho,

versos.hebraico: וְהַ֣חֲסִידָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָפָ֖ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְהַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְהָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃

controles.web: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
controles.kjv: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
controles.livre: E a cegonha, e a garça segundo sua espécie, e a poupa, e o morcego.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶ֑ם לֹ֖א יֵאָכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.
controles.kjv: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
controles.livre: E todo inseto de asas vos será impuro: não se comerá.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־ע֥וֹף טָה֖וֹר תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: Of all clean birds you may eat.
controles.kjv: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
controles.livre: Toda ave limpa comereis.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֣וּ כָל־נְ֠בֵלָה לַגֵּ֨ר אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׁעָרֶ֜יךָ תִּתְּנֶ֣נָּה וַאֲכָלָ֗הּ א֤וֹ מָכֹר֙ לְנָכְרִ֔י כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹֽא־תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
controles.livre: Nenhuma coisa morta comereis: ao estrangeiro que está em tuas povoações a darás, e ele a comerá: ou vende-a ao estrangeiro; porque tu és povo santo ao SENHOR teu Deus. Não cozerás o cabrito no leite de sua mãe.

versos.hebraico: עַשֵּׂ֣ר תְּעַשֵּׂ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל־תְּבוּאַ֣ת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ הַיֹּצֵ֥א הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֥ה שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
controles.livre: Indispensavelmente dizimarás todo o produto de tua semente, que render o campo cada ano.

versos.hebraico: וְאָכַלְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּק֣וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר֮ לְשַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֣וֹ שָׁם֒ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְךָ֙ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֔ךָ וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְךָ֖ וְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֣עַן תִּלְמַ֗ד לְיִרְאָ֛ה אֶת־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

controles.web: You shall eat before Yahweh your God, in the place which he chooses, to cause his name to dwell there, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear Yahweh your God always.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt eat before the Lord thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the Lord thy God always.
controles.livre: E comerás diante do SENHOR teu Deus no lugar que ele escolher para fazer habitar ali seu nome, o dízimo de teu grão, de teu vinho, e de teu azeite, e os primogênitos de tuas manadas, e de tuas gados, para que aprendas a temer ao SENHOR teu Deus todos os dias.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִרְבֶּ֨ה מִמְּךָ֜ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תוּכַ֘ל שְׂאֵתוֹ֒ כִּֽי־יִרְחַ֤ק מִמְּךָ֙ הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לָשׂ֥וּם שְׁמ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם כִּ֥י יְבָרֶכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it, because the place is too far from you, which Yahweh your God shall choose, to set his name there, when Yahweh your God shall bless you;
controles.kjv: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the Lord thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the Lord thy God hath blessed thee:
controles.livre: E se o caminho for tão longo que tu não possas levá-lo por ele, por estar longe de ti o lugar que o SENHOR teu Deus houver escolhido para pôr nele seu nome, quando o SENHOR teu Deus te abençoar,

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֖ה בַּכָּ֑סֶף וְצַרְתָּ֤ הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ בְּיָ֣דְךָ֔ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֙ אֶל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: then you shall turn it into money, and bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.
controles.kjv: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the Lord thy God shall choose:
controles.livre: Então o venderás, e atarás o dinheiro em tua mão, e virás ao lugar que o SENHOR teu Deus escolher;

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֡סֶף בְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁר־תְּאַוֶּ֨ה נַפְשְׁךָ֜ בַּבָּקָ֣ר וּבַצֹּ֗אן וּבַיַּ֨יִן֙ וּבַשֵּׁכָ֔ר וּבְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽשְׁאָלְךָ֖ נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְאָכַ֣לְתָּ שָּׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֖ אַתָּ֥ה וּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires, for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you; and you shall eat there before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the Lord thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,
controles.livre: E darás o dinheiro por tudo o que desejar tua alma, por vacas, ou por ovelhas, ou por vinho, ou por bebida forte, ou por qualquer coisa que tua alma te pedir: e comerás ali diante do SENHOR teu Deus, e te alegrarás tu e tua família.

versos.hebraico: וְהַלֵּוִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תַֽעַזְבֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃ס

controles.web: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.
controles.kjv: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
controles.livre: E não desampararás ao levita que habitar em tuas povoações; porque não tem parte nem herança contigo.

versos.hebraico: מִקְצֵ֣ה׀ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים תּוֹצִיא֙ אֶת־כָּל־מַעְשַׂר֙ תְּבוּאָ֣תְךָ֔ בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִ֑וא וְהִנַּחְתָּ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.
controles.kjv: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:
controles.livre: Ao fim de cada três anos tirarás todo o dízimo de teus produtos daquele ano, e o guardarás em tuas cidades:

versos.hebraico: וּבָ֣א הַלֵּוִ֡י כִּ֣י אֵֽין־לוֹ֩ חֵ֨לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֜ה עִמָּ֗ךְ וְ֠הַגֵּר וְהַיָּת֤וֹם וְהָֽאַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ וְאָכְל֖וּ וְשָׂבֵ֑עוּ לְמַ֤עַן יְבָרֶכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃ס

controles.web: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, and the foreigner living among you, and the fatherless, and the widow, who are within your gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
controles.kjv: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.
controles.livre: E virá o levita, que não tem parte nem herança contigo, e o estrangeiro, e o órfão, e a viúva, que houver em tuas povoações, e comerão e serão saciados; para que o SENHOR teu Deus te abençoe em toda obra de tuas mãos que fizeres.
